data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was $296.795m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $17.675m (5.95% of opening reserves), reflecting overall strengthening of reserves. The managing agent attributes the back-year deterioration to updated reserving assumptions (including a margin above actuarial best estimates), recalibration of IBNR and impacts from inflationary pressures.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2022). Explicit gross prior-year movement figure was not provided; gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (triangle in $'000). The report also states a net deterioration ($10.197k) - that net figure (after reinsurance) was not used as a primary source because a gross triangle was available.
